flags.caption: Jous Drink Pop-Up at SWEAT440 — Join us at the studio for a refreshing pop-up with Jous Drink! Stop by before or after class to enjoy their natural, refreshing beverages.
flags.why: Caption: external beverage brand promoted through an in-studio pop-up, no evidence of approved-partner status. Visual analysis: the official SWEAT440 shield logo appears printed on the Jous can itself — direct co-branding of the mark on a third-party product. Product confirmed non-alcoholic (hydrating fruit drink). Visual finding reinforces the urgency of partner verification.
flags.action: Verify whether Jous Drink is on the approved partners list. If not, request franchisee to document the approval process before any future co-promotions.

flags.caption: FREE B12 SHOTS + Exclusive Wellness Offers! — We're excited to welcome Patriot IV & Pro Health to SWEAT440 for an incredible wellness pop-up offering IV therapy and B12 injections.
flags.why: Caption: medical services provider (IV therapy, B12 injections, peptide therapies, weight-loss consultations) operating inside the studio. Visual analysis: the provider's logo (eagle, star, blood-drop medical imagery) visually dominates the creative and is larger than the SWEAT440 lockup. Regulated medical services promoted under the brand roof with third-party visual prominence. Escalated from LOW to MEDIUM after image review.
flags.action: Verify Patriot IV & Pro Health is on the approved partners list. Low urgency on content policy, but a latent reputational risk if the provider has any issues.

flags.caption: Love is love, and at SWEAT440, strength training is for everyone. We're celebrating Pride with a community class that honors exactly who you are.
flags.why: Caption: Pride-themed community class. Visual analysis: entire creative dedicated to the theme (rainbow border, rainbow typography, LOVE IS LOVE dominant) — active positioning, not passing acknowledgment. Design is clean and on-brand: official SWEAT440 | Toms River lockup correctly applied. No additional visual violations. Remains a judgment call given franchisee and market diversity.
flags.action: Review with leadership. If officially sanctioned network event, document as context. If solo studio initiative, evaluate against brand voice uniformity policy.
